protocol_reconstruction.intended_result: Reproducible flow cytometry identification of a defined target population.
protocol_reconstruction.fragile_step: Antibody staining and FMO-defined gate placement.

evidence_benchmark.benchmark_question: Are FMO controls and compensation details required?

issues.title: Viability gate is missing
issues.specific_problem: The original workflow does not specify a viability gate or fail action.

evidence.claim_supported: Flow-cytometry methods need enough detail to interpret results.

issues.impact: Dead-cell carryover can distort the target-cell frequency.
issues.failure_mode: Non-specific antibody binding is mistaken for true signal.
issues.resolution: Add viability dye, a release threshold, and a repeat or exclusion rule.
issues.decisive_readout: Every sample records viable-cell percentage and the release decision.

qc_and_metadata_review.acceptance_threshold: Local panel threshold recorded before execution
qc_and_metadata_review.measurement_method: Viability dye gate applied before target marker gates
qc_and_metadata_review.fail_action: Repeat preparation or exclude with deviation record

safety_governance_review: Institutional biosafety and sample-handling approvals are recorded before execution.
mini_pilot_plan: Run one positive-control and one negative-control sample before the full batch.

parameter_provenance.value: One FMO control per critical marker
parameter_provenance.local_verification: Flow core confirms marker panel before execution
